observed.caption: A person in a white shirt and black pants sits on a yellow patterned armchair indoors with hands clasped.
observed.description: One person wearing a white short-sleeved shirt, black pants, and shiny black loafers sits on a yellow and white patterned high-back armchair with wooden legs, with hands clasped together resting near the knees and facing the camera. Behind the chair, two large framed abstract artworks with yellow, black, and white shapes hang on a light-colored wall. The floor includes a light tile surface partially covered by a gray rug with overlapping yellow and black circular line patterns. A small round light-brown side table with a tiered pedestal base sits to the right of the chair. The lighting is bright and even, indicating an indoor setting.
